galois_scope: The three prime ideals are Galois-conjugate, but their totally-positive generators and theta*p timelike coefficients are retained separately because embedding zero is the distinguished Lorentzian place.
scope: For each of the three distinguished split-prime-13 directions, every canonical mirror norm, compatible control, D24 root coset, and all seven nonzero D24+ spinor residues are exhausted through exact Vinberg height H=300. No global nonreflectivity conclusion is claimed.

seeds.complete_local_norm_proof: Let p=(p13(theta=7)), generated by -1*theta + 2*theta^2, with N(p)=13, and put I(r)=(theta*p*x,(y,D24+)). Since D24+ is even unimodular, reflection integrality gives (q(r))|2I(r). Away from the inert prime (2) and p, primitivity and self-duality force v(q)=0. At p, either y is primitive and v_p(q)=0, or y lies in pD24+, x is a p-adic unit, and q=-theta*p*x^2 mod p^2 has v_p(q)=1. At (2), evenness and the same divisibility give v_2(q)=0 or 1. Hence the complete norm ideals are (1),(2),p,2p. Class number one and U^+=U^2 give the canonical totally-positive elements 1,2,p,2p.

geometry.engine: exact double description; adjacency by common-active rank 23

p_divisible_spatial_gate.statement: For q=p or 2p, reflection integrality is equivalent to y in pD24+; write y=pz and enumerate z in D24+ at target/p^2.
